'''Module Genic Receptacles''' are items added in [[Version 1.10.0]] of SRP. It is solely used to craft [[Modules]].
{{Item Info
|title1=Module Genic Receptacle
|image1=Module Genic Receptacle.png
|type=Item
|stackable=No
|tooltip=An essential crafting component in both relay and module assembly.
|id=srparasites:module_base}}

== ''Obtainment'' ==
A Module Genic Receptacle can be crafted using four [[Module Tissue Spike|Module Tissue Spikes]], a [[Module Organ Synth]], and four of any Glass.
{{CraftingTable
|r1_a1=Glass
|r1_a2=Module Tissue Spike

|r1_b2=Module Organ Synth
|r1_b3=Module Tissue Spike
|r1_c1=Glass
|r1_c2=Module Tissue Spike
|r1_c3=Glass
|r1_output=Module Genic Receptacle
|r1_count=1
}}
